versions.name: NoOnlineLevelDelete
versions.description: Hides the button to delete your online levels to prevent accidents.

about:
# NoOnlineLevelDelete

This mod removes the delete button on your online levels to prevent accidents.

* Available for Windows, Mac, & Android (not iOS).
changelog:

 * Fixed the mod causing crashes upon entering a current Daily, Weekly, or Event level (top-right delete button does not exist on those menus)
 * Updated description

# v1.0.6

 * Updated mod for use for Geode v5.0.0
 * Dependency for Node IDs is now defined (went unnoticed for over a year, sorry about that)

# v1.0.5

 * Updated mod for use for Geode v4.0.0

# v1.0.4

 * Updated mod for use for Geode v3.0.0

# v1.0.3

 * Added GitHub repository button to the mod

# v1.0.2

 * Changed author's name to DoublefallingS

# v1.0.1
